The sounds in Data\Sound\fo4bowling are cut from real bowling recordings on Freesound, all released under CC0 1.0
(public domain). They were converted to mono 44.1 kHz, trimmed, faded, de-hissed and levelled for the mod; the hits
are a pin knock layered with a pin-on-pin clack or two.

  crash_1, release_1
      "Bowling Ball Hits Pins, Once" by CHallSmith
      https://freesound.org/people/CHallSmith/sounds/870830/
  crash_2   "Bowling Strike" by SieuAmThanh
      https://freesound.org/people/SieuAmThanh/sounds/514385/
  crash_3   "SPRTInd-Int_BowlingStrike_Zus_OwSfx_Hard" by ZusIsKing
      https://freesound.org/people/ZusIsKing/sounds/766871/
  crash_4   "bowling (strike/spare)" by Raclure
      https://freesound.org/people/Raclure/sounds/458869/
  crash_5, crash_6
      "Bowling.wav" by Rehanjo
      https://freesound.org/people/Rehanjo/sounds/593593/
  hit_*     "Single bowling pin knock" by Rvgerxini, with "bowling pins stereo" by Bruce Burbank
      https://freesound.org/people/Rvgerxini/sounds/499788/
      https://freesound.org/people/Bruce%20Burbank/sounds/151204/
  roll_1, release_2
      "Bowling Ball.wav" by driftworks
      https://freesound.org/people/driftworks/sounds/128969/
  pin_*
      "bowling pins mono" by Bruce Burbank
      https://freesound.org/people/Bruce%20Burbank/sounds/151203/
  sweep_*   "Mechanical1" by BMacZero, with the rolling ball (driftworks, slowed) and the pin knocks
      https://freesound.org/people/BMacZero/sounds/94120/
  set_*     "LightClunk1" and "LightClunk2" by BMacZero, with the pin knocks above
      https://freesound.org/people/BMacZero/sounds/94129/
      https://freesound.org/people/BMacZero/sounds/94130/
